direct_evidence_requirements.evidence_level: direct and must agree with source_type
direct_evidence_requirements.local_media_path: absolute path when https url is absent; digest and optional size are read back when present
direct_evidence_requirements.current_hot_readback: current-hot promotion requires readable local media whose stable file identity, byte size and SHA-256 match during readback
direct_evidence_requirements.human_content_review: current-hot promotion requires a digest-bound human review from the last 7 days whose classification matches app_rank_capture or gameplay_capture
direct_evidence_requirements.distinct_role_media: a rank capture digest cannot also satisfy the gameplay capture requirement for the same observation
direct_evidence_requirements.gameplay_capture_time: direct mechanic evidence must declare captured_at within the current-hot window
direct_evidence_requirements.independence_lineage: independence_key collapses the same original lineage; any equal declared evidence_digest also collapses claims across direct/indirect keys
